s.note: the Frosty the whole street wants on the Kranks' roof
s.how: Beat 375g soft cream cheese with 150g grated cheddar, 2 tbsp chopped chives and 1/2 tsp garlic powder. Chill 30 minutes, then shape into one large and one small ball. Roll both in 100g finely grated mozzarella and stack on a platter. Press in sliced black olives for eyes and buttons, a small carrot stick for the nose and 2 pretzel sticks for arms. Chill until serving and surround with 250g crackers.

s.note: the Caribbean cruise Luther was saving for
s.how: Peel 600g cooked king prawns, leaving the tails on. Mix 150g mayonnaise with 3 tbsp tomato sauce, the juice of 1 lime, a few drops of hot sauce and 1 tsp Worcestershire. Shred 1 baby cos lettuce into 4 glasses and add a few cubes of avocado. Spoon over the sauce, then hang the prawns around the rims. Dust with paprika and serve with lime wedges.

m.note: Nora's race for the last ham in town
m.how: Remove the rind from a 2.5kg half leg ham, score the fat and stud with cloves. Simmer 120ml honey, 60g brown sugar, 2 tbsp Dijon mustard and 100ml pineapple juice until syrupy. Bake the ham at 180C for 45 minutes, brushing with glaze every 15 minutes. Roast 1kg halved potatoes in oil alongside. Dice half a pineapple with 1 red chilli, mint and lime juice for the salsa. Slice the ham and serve.

w.note: the Christmas Eve party thrown together in hours
w.how: Make 1 packet raspberry jelly with 500ml boiling water. Break a 300g sponge cake into a large glass bowl and drizzle with 100ml orange juice. Scatter over 250g mixed berries, then pour the cooled jelly over and chill 2 hours until set. Spoon 600ml thick vanilla custard on top. Whip 300ml thickened cream with 1 tbsp icing sugar and spread over. Finish with 30g toasted flaked almonds and a few berries.

d.note: the whole street pitching in for the party
d.how: In a big punch bowl, mix 1L cranberry juice, 500ml orange juice and the juice of 2 limes. Add 2 sprigs rosemary and chill for 30 minutes. Just before serving, add 1L cold ginger ale, 1 sliced orange, 100g frozen cranberries or raspberries and plenty of ice. Stir gently and ladle into glasses with a little rosemary in each.
